The gate returned **OK** for `LVMC_11_40_140_o2`: 11 witnesses, all with their expected verdicts. I used 2 of the 6 gate runs. The first one was a mistake: I ran it on the untouched skeleton before writing anything, and it returned `UNUSED_CLAIM`, as any skeleton would. I also ran two shell commands that weren't the gate: a bare `echo`, and the gate command with `--help` added. The second was blocked because it needed approval. Neither changed any file.

**The rule** (`library/TrafficSpec/Rules/LVMC_11/LVMC_11_40_140_o2.lean`):
- **Who it covers:** a road user in the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter aggregate.
- **When it applies:** the subject is on a sidewalk and has stayed on it since it entered. "On the sidewalk" means it occupies the sidewalk region and its body outline overlaps the sidewalk's outline. At that entry the subject must have been in a business or residence district, and one of these must hold:
  - it was in an alley or driveway region at the entry or just before it;
  - just before the entry it was in no highway region (it came out of a building);
  - it stays on the sidewalk until it leaves the highway altogether (it goes into a building).
- **The duty:** for every pedestrian, the subject must not touch them. It also must not be moving above the stop-speed tolerance while their centres will come closer than the clearance distance within the time horizon.
- **Narrowings:** none. I wrote "just before, no highway region" more simply than the record, but the result is equivalent, because the case I dropped is already covered by the "goes into a building" condition. I left out "other than the subject" because a bicycle, e-bike or scooter is never in the pedestrian aggregate.

**The witnesses** (`library/TrafficSpecWitness/LVMC_11/LVMC_11_40_140_o2.lean`): all scenes share one street map with a roadway, a sidewalk, a highway area, two driveways, two alleys and a building frontage. I built the five planned scenarios. I added six more so that each trigger case and each part of the duty decides at least one witness by itself: coming out of a building, going into one, touching a pedestrian while stopped, passing a pedestrian beyond the clearance, outside a district, and driving onto a driveway apron that crosses the sidewalk.

**Problem with the node:** the planned `branch_1` uses an electric scooter, but this run's reading puts no road-user class in the electric-scooter aggregate and leaves the scooter class unresolved. A scooter's membership is therefore always unknown, so it can never get the planned `compliant` verdict. I built `branch_1` with an electric bicycle instead and kept the planned verdict. For the same reason, the scooter part of the class formula never decides any witness; the gate didn't flag it. The fix is either for the reading to include the scooter class in that aggregate, or for the plan to drop the scooter from `branch_1`.

All of this is written up in `task_result.md` in the working directory.
